Broccoli Slaw With Dried Cranberries
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Sunday, June 5, 2011 - 10:32pm

Ingredients




1 pound broccoli slaw mix
1/4 cup dried cranberries
1 package Ramen noodles
1 cup balsamic vinaigrette dressing
1/4 cup sugar

Preparation

1 In a large bowl, combine broccoli and cranberries 2 In a separate bowl, combine dressing and sugar 3 Crush Ramen noodles 4 Pour dressing over broccoli mixture and stir well to coat 5 Add crushed noodles and stir salad well to thoroughly mix
